title: UISD Trustee Dianelle Martinez Shares Thanksgiving Greeting
excerpt: UISD Board Trustee District 7 Dianelle Martinez shared a Thanksgiving greeting on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, wishing UISD students, employees and families a happy holiday.
content:
UISD Board Trustee District 7 Dianelle Martinez shared a Thanksgiving greeting on Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026.

Martinez wished UISD students, employees and families a Happy Thanksgiving, expressing gratitude for the community and for the trust placed in her to serve, and wishing blessings of love, unity and good health.
